mrAutomationDescription: Wakes this task's agent when your review is requested on a linked merge request, or when one merges or closes. Notifications go to whichever session queue is active for this task.
mrAutomationReviewRequestedHelp: Wake the agent when the workspace's connected GitLab account is added as a reviewer. Being re-added after removal counts as a new request; staying assigned across MR updates does not.
mrAutomationTerminalHelp: Wake the agent when review work ends. Choose either or both outcomes.
mrAutoFixPromptDescription: This prompt is used only for this task. Leave it blank to use the default prompt. Add <0>{{placeholder}}</0> when you want Kandev to include its MR feedback snapshot.
mrAutoFixRoundExplanation: Auto-fix has used {{current}} of {{max}} rounds for this MR. A round is counted when Kandev sends or queues an MR auto-fix message. Kandev waits for the pipeline to finish before starting a new auto-fix turn, so the agent gets the final failing jobs and current discussion comments together. Updating an already queued auto-fix message does not use another round. When this is at {{max}}/{{max}} and there is no pending auto-fix message left to update, Kandev pauses auto-fix for this MR so it cannot loop forever. Disable and re-enable auto-fix after manual review to start over.
mrAutoMergeReadyExplanation: Kandev merges this MR automatically the moment it is fully ready: open and not a draft, its pipeline has succeeded, there are zero unresolved discussions, and GitLab's own merge-readiness check agrees. If your project requires approval, that is already part of GitLab's check; once the MR is approved and every other condition is met, Kandev merges it immediately with no further confirmation.
mrAutomationWatchesLinkedMergeRequest: Watches this task's linked merge request during the 1 minute sync loop. Auto-fix queues task prompts for newly observed pipeline failures or discussion comments, auto-merge waits for the MR to be ready, and the notification switches wake the task's agent when the workspace's connected GitLab account is requested for review or the MR reaches a terminal state. Review requests silently baseline the account's current request state before notifying on a later request.
mrAutomationPlaceholderExplanation: The placeholder inserts the current MR identifier, new or changed failing pipeline jobs with links, and new or changed unresolved discussion comments with file, line, and body text.
mrAutomationOmitPlaceholderExplanation: Omit the placeholder if you want the agent to pull or fetch the branch and inspect GitLab itself instead of receiving Kandev's snapshot.
